sourceAnalysis.observedVsInferred: The 403 is runtime evidence. The period predicate is a concrete static incompatibility for the recorded selected month and real annual source shape. The log does not include the response body or inner read reason, so the first failing internal subgate is not proven. This report does not label the 1.73-second GET as a lease timeout.

mutationIntegrity.fact: context.persistence is the real source-lifecycle wrapper. The raw content transaction runs source/scope synchronization. The driver changes only one forecast number, retaining ids and all ACL/receipt state, and does not mark a dataset replacement.

ownCorrectionAssessment.verdict: No public monthly Planner issuer or equivalent own selection correction was found that preserves this January historical-access counterproof.
rejected: Editing BusinessEvidenceRef.target.period or recomputing its digest would fabricate a narrower producer reference.
Calling the new pure sfPlannerEvidenceRef constructor is not a public authenticated monthly issuer and still emits an annual period.
Changing review-read expectation to 403 would hide the required historical-consumer failure.
Returning to annual selection or deleting the source-change assertion would remove the legitimate monthly counterproof and is not a correction.
An artifact read that bypasses the real review/source authorization is not an acceptable historical consumer.
